intro: First-time or veteran promoter, IBRA helps you get a date on the calendar, a USA Cycling permit, and riders on the start line.
fee_note: No IBRA local association fee for Iowa races.

steps.title: Request a date
steps.text: Email the board with your event, discipline and preferred dates so we can avoid conflicts.

steps.title: Apply for a permit
steps.text: Submit your USA Cycling permit application. We review and approve it as the local association.

steps.title: Line up officials
steps.text: We help connect you with licensed officials for your event.

steps.title: Go live
steps.text: Put your USA Cycling permit number in your BikeReg event. Your race page and registration link appear on the IBRA site automatically.
